blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — SolarEdge StorEdge battery
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS charge and discharge the battery of a SolarEdge StorEdge inverter through the storage remote control of the SolarEdge Modbus Multi integration. While the battery's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, the storage control mode is set to remote control and the Ventra-EMS setpoint (number.ems_<id>_battery_power, in W: − = charge, + = discharge) decides the command: discharge with the setpoint as discharge limit, or charge with it as charge limit (the other limit is 0). While take control is off, the storage control mode is disabled and the command mode set to off, so the inverter runs its own mode again. Checked every 5 seconds and when take control changes. The command mode is written every time (it keeps the inverter's remote control command timeout from running out); the rest only when it differs. The limits' unit (W or kW) is read from the entities and the values are kept inside their range. Version 1.

inputs.description: The battery setpoint made by Ventra-EMS (W), e.g. number.ems_storedge_battery_power.

inputs.title: Storage command mode

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — Solax battery
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS charge and discharge the battery of a Solax inverter through the remote control of the Solax Modbus integration. While the battery's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, the Ventra-EMS setpoint (number.ems_<id>_battery_power, in W: − = charge, + = discharge) goes to the inverter's remote control active power (Solax: + = charge), remote control is enabled and triggered. While take control is off, remote control is disabled and the inverter runs its own mode again. Everything is written every 5 seconds. The active power's unit (W or kW) is read from the entity and the value is kept inside its range. Version 1.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — OCPP EV charger
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS charge an EV through a charger in the OCPP integration (lbbrhzn/ocpp). While the charger's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on and a car is plugged in, the Ventra-EMS power (number.ems_<id>_power, in W: − = charging) is turned into a charging current (amps = power ÷ (phases × voltage), kept between the minimum and maximum current and rounded to the current step) on the charger's maximum current, and charging is switched on. While take control is off, charging is switched off and the maximum current goes back to the minimum. Checked every 15 seconds (OCPP chargers need time per command), when a car is plugged in and when take control changes. Version 1.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — heat pump / air conditioner (relays)
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS switch a heat pump or air conditioner through its relays: main, heating, cooling and hot water (fill in only the ones the device has). While the device's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, each device switch follows its Ventra-EMS relay (switch.ems_<id>_main_relay, switch.ems_<id>_heating_relay, …): on = allowed, off = blocked. Each relay can have extra conditions of your own (for example a room temperature): the switch is only on when the Ventra-EMS relay is on and those conditions are met. While take control is off, this automation leaves the device alone. Checked every 5 seconds; a switch is only changed when it differs. Version 1.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — SolarEdge inverter limit
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS limit the production of a SolarEdge inverter (SolarEdge Modbus Multi). While the inverter's Ventra-EMS "limit control" (switch.ems_<id>_limit_control) is on, the limit control mode is set to production control and the site limit follows the Ventra-EMS power limit (number.ems_<id>_power_limit, in W; the site limit's own unit W or kW is read and the value kept inside its range). While limit control is off, the limit control mode goes back to disabled, so the inverter produces freely. Checked every 5 seconds and when limit control changes; an entity is only written when its value differs. Version 1.

inputs.name: ems_power_limit

inputs.name: option_limiting

inputs.name: option_free

inputs.description: The limit control mode option that lets the inverter produce freely.

blueprints.name: Ventra-EMS — relay device
blueprints.description: Lets Ventra-EMS switch a relay device: a boiler, pool pump, heater or anything a switch, smart plug or relay can turn on and off. While the device's Ventra-EMS "take control" (switch.ems_<id>_take_control) is on, the device switch follows its Ventra-EMS relay (switch.ems_<id>_relay): on = the device may run, off = blocked. While take control is off, Ventra-EMS is not in control and this automation leaves the device alone. Ventra-EMS already applies "Relay closed means" (Allowed or Blocked/SG-ready). Checked every 5 seconds and on every change. For a heat pump or air conditioner, make one automation per relay (main, heating, cooling, hot water), each with the device's take control. Version 2.

inputs.description: The device's relay switch made by Ventra-EMS, e.g. switch.ems_boiler_relay.

inputs.name: device_switch
inputs.title: Device switch
inputs.description: The switch, smart plug or relay that powers the device.
